_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. Names carry their own units and scope: `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party (best member — see PartyBonuses), a bare name is flat. Of what remains, two are NOT gaps and must not be wired: effect_duration_pct duplicates the live Enchantment duration mechanic in _calculate_status_duration, and crafting_quality_pct has no mechanic to attach to — crafted items come from a fixed CRAFT_TABLE with no quality concept. crafting_yield_pct is owned by Alchemy while camp crafting reads Smithing, so it needs a decision about which skill crafts before it can be wired. trap_detection_pct waits on the traps design (see TODO).

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
